summary: The recorded base already contains upstream PR #27869's Qwen3.5 batch-invariance implementation. This contribution adds exact Qwen3.5-27B TP=2 Triton serving regression coverage and GPU kernel-level coverage for the dense model's Gated DeltaNet RMSNorm path. On the assigned MI355X, the same BF16 row was bitwise identical at batch row counts 1 and 1025 and matched an independent FP32 PyTorch reference within the stated tolerance. The reported full TP=2 model-serving workload was not run because only one GPU was assigned and Qwen3.5-27B weights were unavailable, so this is not claimed as a complete end-to-end reproduction of the report.

tests.what_was_measured: Real MI355X execution of the Qwen3.5-27B-shaped BF16 gated RMSNorm kernel: constant deterministic launch geometry over 11 adversarial row counts, bitwise equality for an identical row at batch sizes 1 and 1025, and numerical agreement with an independent FP32 PyTorch reference. Result: 2 passed, 11 subtests passed.
Collection of both the exact Qwen3.5-27B TP=2 Triton deterministic serving tests and focused kernel regression tests. Result: 8 tests collected.
Repository formatting, lint, security, and registered-test CI registry checks for all changed test files.

gpu_execution_evidence: The focused test executed Triton BF16 kernels on GPU 0, AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950), ROCm 7.2, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. The output row was bitwise equal across batch shapes and matched the independent torch.float32 reference.
remaining_limitations: The exact reported server workload requires TP=2, but this job was assigned one GPU.
Qwen/Qwen3.5-27B model weights were not present on the node, so full generation, logprob, parser, 262144-context, and repeated HTTP batch tests were not executed.
The available GPU is AMD MI355X; the pre-existing end-to-end Qwen3.5 deterministic test is registered for NVIDIA H100/FA3. The new exact-issue serving class is collected but was not executed locally.
No native C++ or FlyDSL source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
The Llama fixture from amdpilot-org/sglang PR649 was not used because it cannot qualify Qwen3.5 architecture semantics or the TP=2 distributed path.
